answer: Admission requires a 15-token deposit and a proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty doubles after every 8 identities from one funding cluster. Cloning an orchard of fakes therefore costs 15n tokens plus exponentially rising compute, roughly 2^(n/8). Validators re-hash each posted solution, so any echo of a reused nonce is rejected, and the cheapest mesa of throwaway accounts stays unprofitable.
